CommunityApplications.Profile:
Home of mybabynotes — a self-hosted baby tracker for one household sharing its babies' log: up to six adults (parent and caregiver roles) and up to ten children, with the data in one SQLite file on your own server. No cloud account, no telemetry, no subscription.
It logs in three taps, works offline at 3am and syncs when there's signal, keeps every phone in the household live over websockets, and treats the shift handoff — "I need to sleep, take him" — as a first-class flow rather than a text message. Everything exports to CSV whenever you want it.
This repository ships one Community Apps entry, the all-in-one container (app, API and websockets in a single image, all state in one /data folder). The same project also publishes a Home Assistant add-on and a documented REST API.
